{{Top|leg}}
A '''transpacitor''' was a key [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] component. The fist-sized device would transfer excess heat and power away from the hyperdrive, preventing internal damage. The Transpacitor was very similar to the [[Hyperspace shunt]], and both were widely used in hyperdrive technology.
